lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrCdSe3 crystallizes in the cubic space group P2₁3 (No. 1), with a unit cell containing five atoms across three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Cd and Sr centers, each coordinated by six Se neighbors, while Se adopts an octahedral environment with two Cd and four Sr neighbors. Corner-sharing between Se octahedra and between Cd and Sr octahedra is observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component. Theoretical density is not supplied.
